_doc: REVIEW-W2B-4 item 1: my read of each drawn line (draw4.json, salt review-w2b-4-precision-2026-11-13) against its town's record. F = false on the page (the finding is right); T = not shown false (the finding is wrong). Standard: the third read's (a word naming a power on the town's powers roster is not false; size words to the chair's ruled standard).

T.2: practitioner: 'Readings, visions, and omens from practitioners who know what the client wants to hear.' (the False prophecy service) in a metropolis whose roster holds Charlatan fortune tellers and an Alchemist quarter: the practitioners are the frauds, and they are there
T.10: armedForce: the War tab's 'From here you raise Niederbrücke's troops …' (a village with no standing force): an instruction that the tab raises troops, not a claim that troops stand
T.19: clergy: 'tithes fund civic works and the clergy's opinion on appointments carries decisive weight.' — the Religious Authorities power's own description, that power on the roster at 51
T.47: armedForce: 'The Military Party takes its orders no longer.' — names the Military Party, a power on the roster at 57
T.74: clergy: 'The priest guides the community, and disputes are brought to the priest to settle.' — the Priestly Guidance power's description, that power on the roster
T.77: clergy: the Religious Authorities power's description again (on the roster at 71)
